title.ja: CSVRとLangevin：調和2自由度の分布・揺らぎ・相関
title.en: CSVR versus Langevin: distributions, fluctuations and correlations of two harmonic modes

summary.ja: 異なる周波数を持つ2自由度でglobal CSVRとlocal Langevinを同じOBABO分割で比較。位置・運動量・温度・全エネルギーの分布、揺らぎ、相関を記録します。
summary.en: Compare global CSVR with local Langevin on two nondegenerate modes using the same OBABO splitting. Record position, momentum, temperature and total-energy distributions, fluctuations and correlations.

assumptions.en: m=kB=T=1, omega=(1,1.7), Nf=2. tau=0.25/1, h=0.1/0.05. Evolve 8192 canonically initialized replicas and a separate 4096-replica ensemble with q,p scaled by 1.4 to t=20. Correlation lags are 0/0.5/1/2/4.

algorithm.ja: 両方式とも厳密な浴O(h/2)–velocity-Verlet–O(h/2)（OBABO）。CSVRは全運動量に同じ係数、Langevinは各成分に独立OU雑音を作用。γ=1/(2τ)で自由浴のK緩和時間をそろえます。以前のBAOAB例は変更せず別の分割として残します。
algorithm.en: Both use exact O(h/2)–velocity-Verlet–O(h/2), or OBABO. CSVR applies one factor to all momenta; Langevin uses independent component-wise OU noise. gamma=1/(2 tau) matches bath-only K relaxation. The earlier BAOAB release is retained as a different splitting.

validation.ja: 正準Gaussian・Gamma分布とK/U/Hの平均・分散を照合。有限刻みではVerletのshadow二次形式を使い、位置分散T/[ω²(1−h²ω²/4)]、運動量分散Tを別導出したLyapunov解と比較します。h=0.2/0.1/0.05の決定論的偏りで2次性を確認。Langevinのq,p,K,H相関は独立の離散伝播と照合し、CSVRの相関は独立複製の標準誤差とτ・h依存を表示します。
validation.en: Check canonical Gaussian/Gamma distributions and K/U/H means/variances. For finite steps, compare the Verlet-shadow position variance T/[omega²(1−h² omega²/4)] and momentum variance T against a separately constructed Lyapunov solution. Deterministic biases at h=0.2/0.1/0.05 establish second order. Check Langevin q,p,K,H correlations against independent discrete propagation; report CSVR correlations with independent-replica standard errors and tau/h dependence.

limits.ja: global CSVRとlocal Langevinの運動相関が等しいとは要求しません。CDF差は指定5点の最大であり全実数上のKS距離ではありません。正準初期分布の保存と温度摂動からの有限時間確認は一般のエルゴード性証明ではなく、軸上の励起されない自由度が残る反例もテストします。分子・拘束・BOMDには外挿しません。
limits.en: Global-CSVR and local-Langevin dynamical correlations are not required to agree. CDF errors are maxima over five declared points, not whole-line KS distances. Canonical-start preservation and the heated-start finite-time check do not prove ergodicity; tests retain an invariant unexcited-axis counterexample. No extrapolation to molecules, constraints or BOMD.

references.author: G. Bussi, D. Donadio and M. Parrinello
references.title: Canonical sampling through velocity rescaling

review.ja: 2007年原著の著者稿arXiv:0803.4060v1（2008年掲示）のII.1–II.3、Appendix Aの厳密運動エネルギー更新を確認。SISSAの出版社PDFは取得できず、原著の分子系を再現したものではありません。χ²は直接生成し、著者が後に指摘したΓ生成手順のtypoを写しません。
review.en: Checked theory II.1–II.3 and the exact kinetic-energy propagator in Appendix A of the author manuscript arXiv:0803.4060v1 (posted 2008 for the 2007 article). The SISSA publisher PDF was unavailable. Original molecular applications are not reproduced. Direct chi-square sampling avoids copying the gamma-generation typo later noted by the author.

references.author: G. Bussi and M. Parrinello
references.title: Stochastic thermostats: comparison of local and global schemes

review.ja: 著者稿のI・II節、式(8)の有限刻み更新、式(9)のα符号、同じGaussianの使用、Nf=1のLangevin同値、τ=1/(2γ)を確認。原著Lennard-Jonesの長時間輸送係数は再現していません。
review.en: Checked sections I–II, finite-step update Eq. (8), the sign of alpha in Eq. (9) using the same Gaussian, the Nf=1 Langevin limit and tau=1/(2 gamma). The original long Lennard-Jones transport calculations are not reproduced.

review.ja: 著者の公式アルゴリズム頁にある2007年論文のGaussian二乗和をΓ分布で生成する記述のtypo注記を確認。年は確認年。配布コードの転載ではなく独自実装です。
review.en: Checked the author’s official note identifying a typo in the 2007 paper’s gamma-based generation of Gaussian-square sums. Year is access year. This is an original implementation, not a reproduction of the downloadable code.

comparison_policy.correlation_policy: Measure q,p,K,H separately. Global and local full-MD correlations need not agree.
comparison_policy.heated_start: Finite-time full-support ensemble check, not a general mixing proof.

scope.ja: 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。
scope.en: These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems.
